title: Samsung’s Z Fold 8 Ultra is more of the same, but better than ever
summary: What makes the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra so Ultra? Where the Z Fold 8 is squat and wide, the Fold 8 Ultra retains the thin outer screen and square inner panel of the previous Folds.
